\documentclass[12pt,border=10pt]{standalone}
\usepackage{blogfigure}
\begin{document}
\begin{tikzpicture}[
    var/.style={circle,draw=ink,fill=paper,minimum size=11mm,inner sep=0pt},
    det/.style={figure box,rounded corners=0pt,text width=8mm,minimum width=14mm},
    noise/.style={figure emph arrow},
  ]
  \FigureMasthead{-0.8}{10.0}{5.9}{}{}
  % Top: the probabilistic process.
  \node[var] (tx) at (0,4.3) {$X$};
  \node[var] (ty) at (4.6,4.3) {$Y$};
  \node[var] (tz) at (9.2,4.3) {$Z$};
  \draw[figure arrow] (tx) -- (ty);
  \draw[figure arrow] (ty) -- (tz);

  % Bottom: the same process as deterministic functions fed by independent noise.
  \node[var] (x) at (0,0) {$X$};
  \node[det] (f) at (2.3,0) {$f$};
  \node[var] (y) at (4.6,0) {$Y$};
  \node[det] (g) at (6.9,0) {$g$};
  \node[var] (z) at (9.2,0) {$Z$};
  \draw[figure arrow] (x) -- (f);
  \draw[figure arrow] (f) -- (y);
  \draw[figure arrow] (y) -- (g);
  \draw[figure arrow] (g) -- (z);
  \node (u) at (2.3,2.0) {$U$};
  \node (v) at (6.9,2.0) {$V$};
  \draw[noise] (u) -- (f);
  \draw[noise] (v) -- (g);
  \draw[ink,dashed,line width=.8pt] (1.3,-1.0) rectangle (7.9,1.1);
  \node[anchor=north] at (4.6,-1.15) {$H(X,U,V)=g(f(X,U),V)$};
  \FigureFootRule{-0.8}{10.0}{-2.3}
\end{tikzpicture}
\end{document}
